default: absent -> global; any other word -> "bind: unknown scope '<scope>' - write global, script or once"
doc: How long the binding lasts: until the next global binding, until the running script ends, or until it has run once.
name: scope

value_docs.global: replace every binding of this key and event with this one (with key *, every key's bindings of that event); it stays until the next global binding
value_docs.once: stack it on the key's binding until it has run once, then remove it
value_docs.script: stack it on the key's binding until the running script ends, then remove it
